value.Notes: Optimize and configure your AI + human inbox management layer to monitor replies, classify intent, and trigger fast responses. This ensures interested prospects are handled within minutes of replying, not hours. Industry data shows prospects are up to 4× more likely to book when contacted within the first 5 minutes, with response effectiveness dropping sharply after 15 minutes.

Set up your private sending infrastructure inside of the Dulcy Email Sending Provider so outreach is isolated from shared senders. This improves reputation control, stability, and long-term deliverability performance when compared to public cold email sending tools.

value.Description: If applicable and not already shared in your onboarding form, please provide the email addresses of any additional team members who should be added to the shared Slack workspace so they can receive updates, approvals, and campaign communications.
Please create your account for the Dulcy email service provider and portal if not already completed.

nodes.name: client task - sign up for portal

value.Description: Please review the Start Here and Phase 0 partnership materials to understand the very first steps, campaign structure, communication flow, expectations, and milestones so execution stays aligned and efficient.

Schedule your first three onboarding calls so we can move through setup, offer refinement, and campaign planning without delays. These calls ensure alignment and fast implementation.  Dulcy Onboarding Call (Onboarding Step 1) -> https://calendly.com/d/cm9t-fnp-fys/dulcy-onboarding-call-onboarding-step-1  Cold Funnel Audit (Onboarding Step 2) -> https://calendly.com/dulcymedia/cold-funnel-audit  Cold Sales Review (Onboarding Step 3) -> https://calendly.com/dulcymedia/cold-sales-review  *If you have multiple people attending, you may share the link with them as ask for them to book the same time or let us know and we will add them to the invite

Complete the onboarding form in full so we can collect your offer details, targeting inputs, positioning, access requirements, and campaign constraints. This directly impacts targeting accuracy and campaign performance.  Your Link -> https://airtable.com/appxqINt5XKw7a76A/pagGEsFD84Y2Q48Pi/form

value.Task: Submit Additional Resources to Us (Case Studies, Breakdowns, Lead Magnets, Documents)
value.Description: Share any additional assets that support your credibility and conversion such as case studies, breakdowns, lead magnets, presentations, or supporting documents we can reference in campaigns and reminders.

Please optimize your LinkedIn profile so prospects who search your name after receiving outreach can quickly verify credibility and feel confident booking a meeting. Most recipients will check your website and LinkedIn before replying, so your profile should clearly explain what you do, who you help, and the results you deliver, with a strong headline, updated summary, relevant experience, and a visible call-to-action. I’ve attached a step-by-step optimization guide to follow.  Link -> https://docs.google.com/document/d/1xBeaRrD-9QbDzoKIZCyqBnRkbpd8quOS1M2baUL7b9w/edit?tab=t.0

value.Task: Optimize Landing Page for Frictionless Booking
value.Description: Ensure your primary/cold landing or booking page is clear, fast, and frictionless with a strong headline, clear value proposition, and simple call booking flow to maximize conversion from interested prospects.  Link -> https://docs.google.com/document/d/10Dyi6XuVVFaDhmKLme-WfD_VevbTfb8lyJcUWJAAyk4/edit?tab=t.0

Create a short pre-call VSL that explains what you do, how your service works, and answers the most common questions and objections prospects typically have before a meeting. Please follow your Fanbasis guide (Phase 4 – Cold Funnel Master Class → “How to Use a Pre-Call VSL”) for structure. The goal is to review past sales calls, identify the top 20–25 recurring questions or objections, and address them clearly in one video so prospects arrive informed and ready to focus on their goals. This video can be hosted on a landing page, Wistia, Loom, or embedded in your booking confirmation flow.

value.Task: Submit Items for Email Reminder Sequence
value.Description: Provide 4–8 strong assets such as case studies, testimonials, guides, or educational resources we can include in your pre-call reminder sequence to warm prospects and reinforce credibility before meetings.

value.Task: Share CRM Login / Add scale@dulcy.io as a User
value.Description: Provide CRM access or add scale@dulcy.io as a user so we can configure automations, routing, tracking, and reporting required for campaign execution.

Configure and optimize your booking calendar so prospects can schedule meetings smoothly and without friction. Set correct availability windows, meeting duration (45 minutes), and a 15-minute buffer after each call for notes and objection handling. Ensure routing, time zones, and confirmation settings are correct so meetings are distributed and recorded properly. Add a short, authority-building description on the booking page that clearly states your value proposition, ideal client profile, and any qualification boundaries so only the right prospects book. This helps protect your calendar quality and improves show-up and close rates.  Mine for reference:  Reach 20,000–50,000+ Ideal Clients Every Month with AI Personalized Cold Outreach. Solve consistent lead flow and booked calls with decision-makers who need your service.  2025 Results:  $75M+ in Pipeline Generated 4,000+ Calls Booked  Who We Can’t Help:  Businesses under $500K in annual revenue Direct-to-consumer brands Companies with a TAM of <10K+ prospects  A Few Things to Note:  We don’t do performance-based deals. We don’t do pay-per-call. We don’t do free trials.  Want to see how we can scale your business? Book a free strategy call today.

value.Task: Develop Sales Script w/ Sales Team
value.Description: Work with our sales team to develop and refine your sales script so you can stay natural and authentic on calls while following a proven structure and framing. We’ll help you understand the correct flow, key questions to ask, and how to guide conversations toward a clear next step while handling objections smoothly. The goal is to give you a repeatable format that builds trust, uncovers real needs, and supports a 30%+ close rate through confident, objection-aware conversations.  Dulcy's Sales Script -> https://docs.google.com/document/d/1P0QBPbKFZoxkg25Fu6K4a05m0w03Ov7T4Wp6ALFtUMI/edit?usp=sharing

Create or share your sales tracking sheet so booked calls, outcomes, revenue, and pipeline movement can be measured and optimized over time.  Make a Copy -> https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1tpk7EF-gnY3WxAeAYLeSDxjm7UNjinxlbZBkqBnAhOc/edit?usp=sharing

value.Notes: Configure and train your AI calling employee using your offer, targeting, and conversation rules so it can call interested prospects as soon as a positive reply comes in and introduce a second channel to book meetings. This step takes the longest because the voice agent is built and prompted from scratch, then tested for realism, accuracy, and objection handling to ensure it sounds natural and can correctly answer questions about your business.
